description: This file defines a Python class `OpenAIChatService` that encapsulates chat functionality using LangChain and OpenAI APIs, including environment variable handling, message building, and reply generation.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: A class that handles conversation context and interactions with OpenAI models via LangChain.

methods.name: __init__(self, model: str | None = None, temperature: float = 0.2)
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up the model and temperature, and retrieves API key from environment variables.

methods.name: build_history(self, messages: List[Tuple[str, str]])
methods.description: Transforms a list of (role, message) tuples into LangChain message objects.

methods.name: str generate_reply(self, history: List[Tuple[str, str]], prompt: str)
methods.description: Generates a reply from the AI model based on conversation history and a new prompt.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, model: str | None = None, temperature: float = 0.2):$/
ctags.signature: (self, model: str | None = None, temperature: float = 0.2)

ctags.name: generate_reply
ctags.pattern: /^    def generate_reply(self, history: List[Tuple[str, str]], prompt: str) -> str:$/
